headlines.title: Netflix Looks Attractive to Short-Put Players - a 2.0% One Month Income Yield
headlines.summary: Netflix stock looks attractive to value investors, especially to out-of-the-money (OTM) short-put investors. For example, a 2.0% yield for one month is available on a put option with a 5% lower strike price.

headlines.title: Wall Street Cheers Disney’s Report. Here’s Our New Price Target
headlines.summary: Disney just posted its fifth straight earnings beat and sent streaming profits soaring, but the stock still sits nearly 10% in the red for the year. Our model puts a specific number on where shares go from here and why Wall Street's celebration may still be underselling the real opportunity.

headlines.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Netflix Stock Will Climb or Sink?
headlines.summary: Netflix's weak share price performance over the past year has done little to shake Wall Street's confidence, with analysts maintaining a moderately optimistic outlook on the company's future.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Stock May Be 26% Undervalued Despite New Franchise Rights
headlines.summary: Netflix stock has had a strong run over the past three years, yet current checks still point to a discount, with both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples indicating the shares may be pricing in less than the modelled cash flows. Over the past 3 years, Netflix has returned about 71%, which puts the recent share price weakness into context as a pullback after a longer period of gains.

headlines.title: Get Paid 10% To Cap Your DIS Stock At 8.1% Higher
headlines.summary: For Walt Disney shareholders, here is a way to get paid a meaningful income now, money you keep no matter what, in exchange for agreeing to sell your stock at a higher price if it gets there.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
